name: btn-hover-underline
blurb: Underline animates in from left to right on hover.
description: A simple button with a scale-animated underline that grows from left to right on hover, using a custom cubic-bezier easing for a smooth reveal.
use_when: A minimalist link-like button that needs subtle interactive feedback.
avoid_when: When you need a more prominent hover state.
a11y: Native button element with full keyboard support.
